summary: MLS Compass Iteration 2 tested end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests pass for /api/announcements, /api/links (+section filters), /api/settings, /api/admin/login — including auth (401 without X-Admin-Pin, 200 with 'mls2026') and CRUD Create→Read→Update→Delete flows with persistence assertions. Frontend: Home renders announcements + 'Welcome to MLS Compass' card and Quick Links Student Portal (https://myportal.spcdavao.edu.ph/login). Ask MLS renders real Google Forms iframe with data-testid='ask-form-iframe' pointing at docs.google.com/forms/... URL; Open-in-new-tab CTA matches. Support shows Batch Pulse section with placeholder when pulse_sheet_url empty; setting check_in_form_url via admin Settings tab makes iframe (data-testid='check-in-iframe') render on Support page. Resources page renders useful links from API including Student Portal with correct URL. Admin panel shows all 5 tabs (Announcements, FAQs, Upper-Year Quotes, Links, Settings). Announcement/Link create+delete verified via API and UI. Settings save shows success toast and persists.
action_items: OPTIONAL/LOW: SettingsManager (Admin.jsx) initializes local state with empty strings and PUTs the entire state on Save. If the user clicks 'Save settings' before the GET /api/settings response resolves, all fields get overwritten with empty strings. Consider disabling the Save button until initial load completes, or PUT only changed fields. Reproduced accidentally by the test cleanup — recovered via API restore.
OPTIONAL/LOW: Home.jsx quick-link testid uses label.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,'-') which will collide if two Quick Links share the same label. Not currently an issue with seed data.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'). Migrate to lifespan handlers when convenient.
server.py is ~440 lines — still manageable, but future growth should split routers into modules (faqs, quotes, announcements, links, settings).
Admin SettingsManager should guard against saving empty defaults before initial GET resolves (see action item).
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds on startup: 11 FAQs, 6 quotes, 1 announcement ('Welcome to MLS Compass'), 12 links (6 quick + 6 useful), settings doc with ask_form_url set to Google Forms embed URL. All seed data verified present via GET endpoints.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-2 features work end-to-end. If retesting, the SettingsManager save-before-load race can wipe seeded settings — use API to restore via PUT /api/settings with X-Admin-Pin: mls2026. Data restored after this run: ask_form_url set to Google Forms URL, org_name set. Test data TEST_UI_Announcement cleaned up.
